final: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT tw.weathprofile, AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(tw.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(tw.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
